title: Exact sparse spectrum query budget
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, define the exact sparse spectrum query budget to be $1$ if $n=0$, and otherwise to be the deterministic Goldreich–Levin query budget of the exact sparse-spectrum input with parameters $n$ and $k$.
caveat: The supplied context does not define the exact sparse-spectrum input or the deterministic Goldreich–Levin query budget, so their meanings cannot be stated more explicitly.
